name: tsbootstrap
title: Stationary and block bootstrap. The start index is (int)(unif_rand()*n+1). The stationary length is Ahrens-Dieter exp_rand.

origin.description: Stationary and block bootstrap. The start index is (int)(unif_rand()*n+1). The stationary length is Ahrens-Dieter exp_rand.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The series, matrix, or path this function accepts.

origin.details: Stationary and block bootstrap. The start index is (int)(unif_rand()*n+1). The stationary length is Ahrens-Dieter exp_rand.
origin.value: The same value tseries 0.10-63 returns for this case, written as one line.
origin.example:
z <- sin((1:12)/3)
set.seed(1); a <- tsbootstrap(z, b = 4, type = "stationary")
set.seed(1); b <- tsbootstrap(z, b = 4, type = "block")
set.seed(4); c <- tsbootstrap(sin((1:16)/3), nb = 2, statistic = function(v) v[1], b = 5, type = "block")
paste(join(a), join(b), cell(c$orig.statistic), cell(c$bias), join(c$statistic), sep = "|")

translation.description: Stationary and block bootstrap. The start index is (int)(unif_rand()*n+1). The stationary length is Ahrens-Dieter exp_rand.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The series, matrix, or path this function accepts.

translation.details: Stationary and block bootstrap. The start index is (int)(unif_rand()*n+1). The stationary length is Ahrens-Dieter exp_rand.
translation.value: The same value tseries 0.10-63 returns for this case, written as one line.
translation.example:
z = np.array([math.sin(i / 3) for i in range(1, 13)])
set_seed(1); a = tsbootstrap(z, b=4, type="stationary")
set_seed(1); b = tsbootstrap(z, b=4, type="block")
set_seed(4); c = tsbootstrap(np.array([math.sin(i / 3) for i in range(1, 17)]), nb=2, statistic=lambda v: v[0], b=5, type="block")
return "|".join([join(a), join(b), cell(float(np.ravel(c["orig_statistic"])[0])), cell(float(np.ravel(c["bias"])[0])), join(c["statistic"])])
